content.short: Newton Fund is a specialized investment vehicle focused on supporting high-potential projects on TON.
content.description: Newton Fund is a strategic investment and support platform dedicated to the growth and professionalization of the TON blockchain ecosystem. It functions as a venture capital entity, identifying and funding high-potential projects across categories such as DeFi, infrastructure, and gaming. Beyond financial support, Newton Fund often provides strategic guidance and networking opportunities for its portfolio companies, helping them navigate the complexities of the Web3 market and scale their operations to reach a global audience of TON users.
